verdict.rationale: Make's own docs show webhooks that external apps or services can call to trigger scenario execution, so the product can start workflows from outside events. The custom-app framework also lists Webhooks as an app component. However, the evidence never shows native connected-app event triggers such as new record, new email, or form submission. Missing for 10: documented app-specific event triggers (new record, message, email, form submission), a catalog of instant or polling triggers in connected apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service, or from another use webhooks to trigger the execution
